### Feeding Four Thousand
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/feeding-four-thousand
Passage: Mark 8:1-10
Points:
- Jesus feeding the four thousand demonstrates that His provision extends to both Jews and Gentiles.
- Christ is the living bread who abundantly satisfies all people who come to Him.
- The disciples quickly forgot Jesus' previous miracle and doubted how the crowd could be fed.
- Believers are often prone to focus on present obstacles and forget God's past faithfulness.
- Remembering how the Lord delivered us from sin strengthens our trust in His ongoing care.
